step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identified core services from visual inventory and transcript: Amazon Connect as the main telephony hub, AWS Lambda for data dips to Salesforce CRM, Amazon S3 (top) and Amazon Athena for reporting/analytics, Amazon S3 (bottom), Amazon Transcribe, and Amazon Comprehend for post-call processing and sentiment analysis, plus a secondary AWS Lambda node.
2. Pruned generic human actor 'USERS' per Node Rule 5.
3. Segmented logical workflows into three distinct flow IDs: Flow 0 for CRM data lookup (Connect -> Lambda -> Salesforce), Flow 1 for analytics reporting (Connect -> S3 -> Athena), and Flow 2 for post-call transcription and sentiment analysis (Connect -> S3 -> Transcribe -> Comprehend).
4. Mapped all service names strictly to the valid vocabulary list (Salesforce as ThirdParty).

graph.name: Intuit - Global Contact Center Architecture with Amazon Connect
graph.notes: Intuit leverages Amazon Connect alongside serverless AWS services (Lambda, S3, Athena, Transcribe, Comprehend) and Salesforce CRM to power their global contact centers and analyze customer interactions.

nodes.name: Amazon Connect
nodes.notes: Main contact center service handling inbound calls and user telephony interactions.

nodes.name: AWS Lambda (Data Dip)
nodes.notes: Performs real-time data dips to fetch customer context during calls.

nodes.name: Salesforce
nodes.notes: External CRM system providing customer profile data.

nodes.name: Amazon S3 (Reporting Data)
nodes.notes: Stores call center event metrics and logs for analytics.

nodes.name: Amazon Athena
nodes.notes: Queries event data in S3 to power contact center operational dashboards.

nodes.name: Amazon Transcribe
nodes.notes: Converts call audio recordings stored in S3 into text transcriptions.

nodes.name: Amazon Comprehend
nodes.notes: Analyzes transcription text for sentiment analysis and post-call insights.

edges.notes: Amazon Connect triggers Lambda to execute a customer data dip.
Lambda queries Salesforce CRM for customer information.
Salesforce returns customer details to Lambda.
Amazon Connect streams event and metric data into S3.
Athena queries event metrics in S3 for reporting.
Completed call recordings are saved to S3.
S3 audio recording is sent to Amazon Transcribe for speech-to-text conversion.
Transcribed speech text is sent to Amazon Comprehend for sentiment analysis.
